all.src: LEVEL 2 LEGAL: two long options, no short legs, no uncovered exposure. Fully executable on Alpaca Level 3. This is one of the few entries in this family with no approval obstacle at all.

As a non-arbitrage volatility trade (guts held for a large move), require IV rank < 25 and an expected catalyst, and note that it is capital-inefficient versus a standard strangle for identical exposure — the extra capital is the embedded (K2 - K1) that is returned at expiry.
Both legs quoted within 2 seconds, displayed size >= 10, OI >= 100, same expiry.

management.src: If entered as a volatility trade, close at 100% of the debit above the floor, or at 21 DTE, whichever comes first.

exits.src: BOTH legs are ITM by construction, so BOTH will be auto-exercised at expiry if held: the call buys 100 shares and the put sells 100 shares, netting flat but moving $20,000+ of stock through the account with settlement-timing exposure. Close both legs by 15:00 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
